requirements.configuration: Runtime server environment supplies LIVEKIT_URL, LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET outside source. Caller supplies roomPrefix including its separator, authenticated participant identity, display/capture callback, sound callbacks and event name. No credentials are collected into source templates.

buildInputs: Browser livekit-client 2.23.0 and TypeScript 5.9.3 are locked in package-lock.json. Server uses WebCrypto only. interfaces/native-dependencies.json identifies resolved native locks, checksums and standalone Apple/Android hosts. Android controlled lifecycle tests use the internal roomFactory/scope constructor; public construction is unchanged. Apple test execution and provider interoperability remain unverified.

lifecycle.browser: Constructor registers modeEvent. Publish initial display mode before connecting. A false canCapture callback on that event disconnects and forgets the grant. close disconnects and removes the listener. Hold preserves preferences; idle disconnect retains a retry grant. Generation checks reject stale completion.
lifecycle.apple: Call on the main actor. Native caller disconnects immediately on display entry; the callback alone does not stop an already active track. disconnect forgets the grant; pauseForIdle saves it for resumeFromPause. background stops camera and preserves microphone preference. Sound storage belongs to soundOn/soundChanged callbacks.
lifecycle.android: Call from the main thread. Native caller calls forget on display entry or room leave. disconnect releases the room but retains the grant for idle retry; forget clears it; close forgets and cancels the session scope. background stops camera and preserves microphone preference.
lifecycle.server: Authenticated recipe supplies participant identity and room prefix including separator, uses publish=false for spectators, and issues no display grant. Room routes independently enforce authentication and privacy. listRooms converts ws/wss to http/https and preserves host/port/base path; unsupported/malformed addresses or credentials/query/fragment return null without fetching. Account-wide listing before prefix filtering is unchanged.
